hooks.command: mapped=$(git status --porcelain -- server.js summarizer.js server/summarization.js public/ 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}' | grep -E '\.js$'); if [ -n "$mapped" ]; then queue_entries=$(find .agent/code-map/queue -maxdepth 1 -name '*.json' 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$queue_entries" ]; then files=$(echo "$mapped" | tr '\n' ' '); reason="Mapped files changed with no code-map queue entry: ${files}Append a JSON entry to .agent/code-map/queue/ describing the change (see the map-code skill) before finishing."; jq -n --arg reason "$reason" '{decision:"block", reason:$reason}'; exit 0; fi; fi; exit 0
